import re
from collections import Counter

def top_k_frequent_words(text: str, k: int) -> list[str]:
    if k <= 0:
        return []
    
    # Extract words and convert to lower case
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    
    # Count word frequencies
    word_counts = Counter(words)
    
    # Get the top k most frequent words
    top_k = word_counts.most_common(k)
    
    # Sort by frequency descending and then by word lexicographically
    top_k.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    
    # Return the words only
    return [word for word, count in top_k]

import re

def generate_slug(title: str, max_length: int = 50) -> str:
    if not title:
        return ""
    
    # Convert to lowercase
    title = title.lower()
    
    # Replace consecutive non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
    title = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', title)
    
    # Trim leading and trailing hyphens
    title = title.strip('-')
    
    # Truncate to max_length, ensuring words are not split
    if len(title) > max_length:
        words = title.split('-')
        truncated = []
        for word in words:
            if len('-'.join(truncated) + '-' + word) <= max_length:
                truncated.append(word)
            else:
                break
        title = '-'.join(truncated)
    
    return title

import bisect

def sliding_window_median(nums: list[float], k: int) -> list[float]:
    if k <= 0 or k > len(nums):
        return []
    
    result = []
    window = sorted(nums[:k])
    median = window[k // 2] if k % 2 != 0 else (window[k // 2 - 1] + window[k // 2]) / 2
    result.append(round(median, 2))
    
    for i in range(k, len(nums)):
        window.remove(nums[i - k])
        bisect.insort(window, nums[i])
        median = window[k // 2] if k % 2 != 0 else (window[k // 2 - 1] + window[k // 2]) / 2
        result.append(round(median, 2))
    
    return result
